grades.question: Describe battle from ambush through removal: foiling, early ending, dice limits, extra hits, removal priorities and who scores removed buildings/tokens.
grades.expected_answer: Defender may ambush matching clearing; attacker may foil with matching ambush. Unfoiled ambush deals two immediate hits; discard defender ambush, end battle if no attacking warriors/pawns remain. Before-roll effects, roll high attacker/low defender, rolled hits capped by own warriors, after-roll effects, count hits including uncapped extra hits and defenseless extra attacker hit if no defending warriors, then deal hits. Each side chooses own removals, warriors first. Whoever removes enemy building/token scores one, including defender.

observed.answer: Battle requires your warriors or pawn and an enemy in the chosen clearing; rule is not required. The defender may play a matching-suit ambush (birds wild); attacker may foil with a matching ambush, in which case no hits are dealt. Otherwise the ambush causes two immediate hits, not limited by defending warriors; battle ends if the attacker then has no warriors/pawns. Resolve before-roll effects (attacker orders if both sides have them), roll: high die is attacker's hits and low die defender's, equal dice give equal results; each side's rolled hits are capped by its own warriors in battle, Alliance reverses dice, and Vagabond uses undamaged swords instead of warriors. Resolve after-roll effects, then add extra hits (uncapped) and subtract ignored hits. If defender has no warriors, attacker adds one defenseless hit (Vagabond is defenseless only without undamaged swords). For each side's hits, that side chooses its own pieces to remove, but all warriors must go before buildings/tokens; it also orders effects triggered by its pieces' removal. Both sides deal their counted hits, and warrior losses do not change the rolled cap retroactively. Removing an enemy building/token scores one VP for the remover, whether attacker or defender and even outside battle. Vagabond takes hits as item damage.
